why_it_passes: A clear card whose question, in other words, is the open backup server card's: one answer settles both.

card.title: Second server so bookings never stop?
card.context: Our clinics' data lives on a single server. When it failed in the spring, nobody could book patients for six hours. For $30 a month the hosting company runs a standby that takes over on its own; the hosting agent can switch it on today.
card.question: Do we pay $30 a month for a standby server that takes over if ours fails?

choices.label: No
choices.cons: another outage stops bookings for hours

card.why: One outage costs clinics more than a year of the standby.

open_cards.title: Pay for a second server?
open_cards.context: All clinic data is on one server; a backup that takes over by itself costs $30 a month.
open_cards.question: Should the agent add a backup server for $30 a month?

open_cards.title: Move email to a new company?
open_cards.context: Our email company raises its price by half next month; another company costs the same as today.
open_cards.question: Should we move our email to the other company before the price rises?
